description: D-Link (India) Limited engages in the marketing and distribution of D-Link branded networking products for small and medium businesses, residential users, and service providers in India and internationally. It offers home networking products, such as Wi-Fi systems, 4G/5G, cameras, smart home, switches, and adapters, as well as switches, wireless, nuclias, IP surveillance, industrial switches, and accessories. The company also provides Wi-Fi routers and mesh systems; unmanaged switches; security components, such as cables and SMPS; and mobile adapters, power strips, and versatile c-to-c cables. In addition, it offers switching, wireless, network management, network enclosures, and structured cabling solutions. The company was formerly known as Smartlink Network Systems Limited. D-Link (India) Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of D-Link Holding Mauritius, Inc.
